messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #22341 is ready for final review. Scope: prefer-vec4 kernel toggle + small change to model-cache auth header (no key rotation). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/22341. Goal: merge Tue 12:00 PT (48h). Need: runtime to sanity-check kernel fallback logic, platform to own canary schedule + rollout, security to confirm the header/audit delta.

sanjay: I can take the runtime review today. Quick Q: did you touch kernel selection heuristics or just add a flag? I only see --prefer-vec4 in the config diff.

maya: just the flag + a small guard so fallback to scalar path stays identical. Perf numbers looked good (+~8% throughput on small-seq tests). Snippet: ```yaml
runtime_flags:
  prefer_vec4: true
  vec4_fallback: true
```

kevin: I can own the canary + merge window if needed. Need the canary spec though — nodes, traffic %, abort criteria? Also please paste the exact deploy command you'll use so I can rehearse.

maya: Canary spec: 3 nodes across AZs, 5% traffic, 15 min ramp, abort if p95 latency > baseline *1.2 OR error rate > 1%. Deploy command: `infra deploy --canary pr-22341 --nodes 3 --traffic 0.05`

alice: For security, what exactly is changing for the model-cache auth header? Are we introducing a new header that could leak PII or sensitive metadata? I need the threat model + what we log for audit.

maya: Not adding PII. We're adding X-Cache-Auth: <service-sig> to internal calls for authz; no end-user tokens in headers. Audit change: model-cache will emit an entry `audit(event="cache_auth", src=service, tag=route)` (we'll add a brief note to the PR).

ops-bot: deploy-queue: canary slots available Mon 09:00-11:00 PT and Tue 11:00-13:00 PT. No conflicting reserved slots.

sanjay: I'll finish the runtime review by EOD and call out any kernel regressions. I won't be available to own the Tue 12:00 window though. @kevin can you be the merge owner?

kevin: Yep, I can own merge + canary ops. I'll schedule the Tue 12:00 slot and write a short playbook (rollback steps + monitoring queries). @alice please ping here when you sign off so I can flip traffic.

alice: Reviewing now. If nothing surprising, I can sign off within ~2 hrs. If I find anything, I'll request a quick patch.

maya: Awesome — thanks. I'll wait for runtime + security thumbs before the canary go. If all thumbs, I'll merge at Tue 12:00 PT and @kevin will run the canary. :thumbsup:

kevin: Sounds good. I'll post the canary playbook in #eng once it's scheduled.

maya: small note for reviewers — perf job IDs: perf/seq-small/2026-03-17-vec4-01. Logs attached in the PR.

ops-bot: reminder: make sure to add a post-canary eval step to the rollout (canary -> 50% -> 100% requires green perf eval).
